properties.notes: Demolition behind retained front facade of No.36 and No.94, including the demolition of existing rear basement and ground extensions and roofs to Nos.36-40. Minor excavation to the rear of Nos. 36-40, and rebuilding to provide part four and part five storey (above ground) buildings at No.36 and No.94. Erection of mansard roof to Nos.38-40 in connection with the use of part of basement and ground for either retail (Class A1) or restaurant (Class A3) and the use of the remaining buildings as 17 residential units. Associated external alterations including rear terrace at first, second, fourth and roof level.
